entries.wants: summary of `hmz devices`: list and revoke the devices paired with this daemon
entries.where: command summary in a --help listing
entries.text: list and revoke the devices paired with this daemon

entries.wants: paragraph for `hmz devices`: a paired device is a phone, browser or other machine let in to this daemon by claiming a pairing code; these commands list them and revoke one
entries.where: paragraph of --help, one or two sentences
entries.text: A paired device is a phone, browser or other machine let in to this daemon by claiming a pairing code. These commands list them and revoke one.

entries.wants: summary of `hmz devices list`: list the paired devices
entries.where: command summary in a --help listing
entries.text: list the paired devices

entries.wants: summary of `hmz devices revoke NAME`: revoke one paired device and close the sessions it has open
entries.where: command summary in a --help listing
entries.text: revoke one paired device and close its open sessions

entries.wants: summary of `hmz devices pair`: make a pairing code for one device to claim
entries.where: command summary in a --help listing
entries.text: make a pairing code for one device to claim

entries.wants: paragraph for `hmz devices pair`: prints a pairing code; the code is entered on the device (web page Settings > Daemons, or the desktop app) to pair it with this daemon before the code expires; each code pairs one device
entries.where: paragraph of --help, two sentences at most
entries.text: Prints a one-time pairing code. Enter it on the device (in Settings > Daemons, or the desktop app) before it expires.

entries.wants: the NAME argument of `hmz devices revoke`: the name the device was paired as, as `hmz devices list` prints it; keep the backticks
entries.where: argument description, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: the name the device was paired as, as `hmz devices list` prints it

entries.wants: the --route ROUTE option of `hmz devices pair`: a route the code carries for reaching this daemon; when not given, the routes the daemon listens on
entries.where: option description, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: a route the code carries to reach this daemon, or those it listens on

entries.wants: the --seconds N option of `hmz devices pair`: how long the code can be claimed for, in seconds
entries.where: option description, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: how long the code can be claimed for, in seconds

entries.wants: what `hmz devices list` prints as text: one line per device: name, fingerprint, when it was paired, when it was last seen
entries.where: sentence in the Output section of --help
entries.text: One line per device: name, fingerprint, when it was paired, when it was last seen.

entries.wants: what `hmz devices revoke` prints as text: how many sessions were closed
entries.where: sentence in the Output section of --help
entries.text: How many sessions were closed.

entries.wants: what `hmz devices pair` prints as text: the code alone on standard output, and when it expires on standard error
entries.where: sentence in the Output section of --help
entries.text: The code alone on standard output, and when it expires on standard error.

entries.wants: JSON field devices: the paired devices
entries.where: description of one field of a JSON document, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: the paired devices

entries.wants: JSON field devices[].name: the name the device was paired as
entries.where: description of one field of a JSON document, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: the name the device was paired as

entries.wants: JSON field devices[].fingerprint: fingerprint of the device's certificate
entries.where: description of one field of a JSON document, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: fingerprint of the device's certificate

entries.wants: JSON field devices[].added: when it was paired, ISO 8601
entries.where: description of one field of a JSON document, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: when it was paired, ISO 8601

entries.wants: JSON field devices[].seen: when it last opened a session, ISO 8601, or null if never
entries.where: description of one field of a JSON document, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: when it last opened a session, ISO 8601, or null if never

entries.wants: JSON field dropped: how many of the device's open sessions were closed
entries.where: description of one field of a JSON document, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: how many of the device's open sessions were closed

entries.wants: JSON field code: the pairing code
entries.where: description of one field of a JSON document, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: the pairing code

entries.wants: JSON field expires: when the code stops being claimable, seconds since the Unix epoch
entries.where: description of one field of a JSON document, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: when the code stops being claimable, seconds since the Unix epoch

entries.wants: example: list the paired devices
entries.where: what an example command does, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: list the paired devices

entries.wants: example: list the paired devices as JSON and print their names with jq
entries.where: what an example command does, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: list the paired devices as JSON and print their names with jq

entries.wants: example: revoke the device paired as `phone`
entries.where: what an example command does, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: revoke the device paired as `phone`

entries.wants: example: make a pairing code that can be claimed for ten minutes
entries.where: what an example command does, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: make a pairing code that can be claimed for ten minutes

entries.wants: message after revoking a device: {n} sessions closed (keep {n})
entries.where: one line printed after `hmz devices revoke`, sentence with full stop
entries.text: Device revoked ({n} sessions closed).

entries.wants: message printed with a pairing code: claim this code on the device before {time}
entries.where: one line on standard error, sentence with full stop
entries.text: Claim this code on the device before {time}.
